preview: This episode examines a test of an AI service that makes phone calls for users. It shows how people working behind an AI service can raise concerns about privacy and trust. Listen to learn why this matters when AI is used to handle everyday tasks.
comment_1: Listen for who is making the calls in some tests, and what users are told about it.
comment_2: The key issue was whether users knew who was really speaking on the call. So what other concern came up when human workers handled these calls?
comment_3: The main problem was that users might not know whether a person or AI was speaking. There was also concern that user information could reach the people making the calls. Next, listen for what happened after these concerns were raised.
comment_4: This story was not only about whether AI could make phone calls. It also raised questions about clear communication and privacy when people were working behind the scenes. Now, let’s bring the story together in the closing summary.
